thread:
Anika (PM): Quick async standup for the roadmap sprint — focusing on spec signoff + launch prep for embed-cache v1.
Sam (Eng): TL;DR what I did: landed the cache eviction patch and added docs for the TTL knob. Blockers: need product signoff on behavior for cold-cache fallback. Today: wire up canary policy and CR for rollout.
Lee (Eng-ML): Did model variant perf tests overnight. Results: quantized 4-bit gives 15% cost drop, 6% latency increase at 2k seq. Adding sample traces to the doc.
Maria (Prod-Ops): FYI, we have a capacity window on Thursday — recommend limiting big canaries to off-peak. Also need an owner for the rollback runbook.
Anika (PM): @Sam can you paste the short spec diff? I want to make sure product language matches eng intent before signoff.
Sam (Eng): sure, gist: added `fallback_policy: cold-serve` default + `max_prefetch_tokens: 512`. Small snippet below:
```yaml
cache: 
  fallback_policy: cold-serve
  max_prefetch_tokens: 512
```
Anika (PM): OK wording: change to "fallback to cold model when cache miss exceeds X qps" — we should avoid internal jargon. I'll update and ping legal for data note.
Lee (Eng-ML): Re: quality, quantized path degrades a few prompt types. Suggest we gate quantized by model-tag `quantizable:true` and flag rollout for 10% traffic initially.
PJ (SRE): Can we agree on canary QPS? I recommend 5% traffic cap or explicit qps limit 200 qps, whichever lower. Also need smoke tests.
Sam (Eng): I'll add a canary config with `traffic_percent: 5`, `qps_limit: 200`, and smoke test hook. Smoke test command: `./scripts/smoke-run --canary-id $ID`
Maria (Prod-Ops): I'll own the rollback runbook and create a short checklist in Ops Runbooks. Assigning to Maria.
Anika (PM): Great; blockers list: 1) spec wording (action: Anika), 2) canary config + smoke test (Sam), 3) runbook page (Maria), 4) perf signoff for quantized variant (Lee). Anyone else?
Sam (Eng): CRs: pinging @Lee and @PJ on PR #4821 — need quick review for gating hooks.
Lee (Eng-ML): On it, I'll scan now.
PJ (SRE): Quick note: please include the metrics we'll monitor in the canary dashboard — latency p95, error-rate, cpu/gpu utilization, and token-cost delta.
Anika (PM): I'll add those metrics to the launch checklist. Can we get agreement on SLA fallback? If canary shows regressions, immediate fallback to hosted default variant.
Sam (Eng): Agreed. We'll wire the policy so the router drops back to hosted-default automatically if p95 > baseline * 1.2 or error-rate > 0.5%.
Maria (Prod-Ops): I'll schedule a 30-min dry run in staging Wed 10:30am PT. Please make test data available by EOD Tuesday.
Anika (PM): Who will prepare the test prompts? @Lee?
Lee (Eng-ML): Yep, I'll curate a 200-prompt set covering long-tail token patterns and ambiguous completions.
Sam (Eng): Small ask: can someone with prod console access confirm we have trace sampling for these requests? I don't want to lose traces on canary.
PJ (SRE): Confirmed. Trace sampling set to 5% globally, canary will have 100% sampling for the canary ID. I'll add that to the runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary-config-v1 -> staging at 2024-11-20T10:30:00Z (user: Sam).
Anika (PM): Awesome. Final question: prioritization — should we move this ahead of the routing QoS item? I think embed-cache unlocks 2x token-cost savings for small customers.
Maria (Prod-Ops): I'm in favor of moving it up one slot. Ops dependency is small and it's customer-visible.
Lee (Eng-ML): Agree — but only if we keep a conservative quantize rollout.
Sam (Eng): Fine by eng. We've got capacity if SRE confirms the low-traffic window.
Anika (PM): OK decision: promote embed-cache to top of next sprint backlog, keep routing QoS next. Action owners listed in checklist.
Sam (Eng): I'll update PR and attach spec diff after Anika's wording tweak. Ping me for review.
Anika (PM): I'll update the spec now and post the final doc here. Thanks team — will follow up with a 2-line summary once the doc is live. :thumbsup:
Lee (Eng-ML): Thanks — I'll finish test prompts and share by EOD.
PJ (SRE): I'll add runbook + dashboard widgets.
Maria (Prod-Ops): Scheduling staging dry run and will ping stakeholders.
Sam (Eng): quick CR ping: @Lee @PJ on #4821 — gentle reminder.
Anika (PM): End of thread — keeping async for small followups.
